notes: New: search all your notes at once. Press Ctrl+Shift+Alt+N (remappable in Settings) to open a search box — find a note by its text or the file's name, then jump straight to it in Explorer.
Fixed: notes on folders sometimes didn't show up again after being saved.
New brand identity: a fresh app icon and a small ink-drop mark in place of the old emoji, throughout the app and installer.
Fixed the same reopening bug for the Delete confirmation: clicking Delete after canceling an edit could silently reset back to normal instead of showing the confirm prompt.
Actually fixed the Close button needing two clicks. The real cause: clicking the bar could trigger an immediate re-check that saw the note's file still selected and popped the bar right back open.
Fixed: the first time you closed a note after starting FootNote, the Close button needed two clicks instead of one.
Fixed: turning on ink bloom made the whole bar noticeably taller. It now keeps its original size.
Fixed the ink bloom rendering as a hard-edged rectangle with visible background bleed-through instead of a soft glow, on some systems.
Ink bloom is now on by default, with swatches and a hex box to change its color in Settings → Panel.
New: optional ink bloom, a soft colored glow behind every note card (Settings → Panel). Off by default.
First release of FootNote: attach a personal note to any file or folder with Shift+Alt+N.
Notes are stored with the file itself and sync across your PCs through Google Drive or OneDrive.
Recover Notes, panel appearance settings, remappable hotkey, and a clean per-user installer.
